overview: Dr. Bodduluri is an Assistant Professor of Medicine in Pulmonary, Allergy, and Critical Care and Director of AI research at UAB's Center for Lung Analytics and Imaging Research (CLAIR). He also serves as Director of AI programs at Marnix E. Heersink Institute for Biomedical Innovation (MHIBI) overseeing Graduate Certificate and MS AI in Medicine degree programs at Heersink School of Medicine. He also holds teaching appointments in Electrical and Computer Engineering. He obtained his MS and PhD in Biomedical Engineering from University of Iowa.
